The variable `_target` is defined using only the value of `$CARCH`, a standard Arch Linux build variable, with no side effects.

There are no top-level commands, `curl`/`wget` invocations, `eval` calls, or data exfiltration attempts outside of function definitions. All potentially sensitive logic is confined within functions that are not executed during this phase.
</details>

All operations are transparent and confined to the build environment.

The `install-skill.sh` script is installed but not executed by the PKGBUILD. There is no evidence of obfuscated code, unauthorized data exfiltration, or execution of external payloads. The package behaves as expected for a CLI tool distributed via AUR.
</details>
